name: 29554 · Hemingway, SC
findings: ZIP 29554 (Hemingway) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29554 (Hemingway) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
